literal: The elder to [the] elect lady and to the children of her, whom I love in truth, and not I alone but also all the [ones] having known the truth,
prose: The elder, to the elect lady and her children, whom I love in truth—and not I only, but also all who have come to know the truth—

literal: because of the truth [that] abides in us, and [it] will be with us into the age;
prose: because of the truth that abides in us, and will be with us forever;

literal: Will be with us grace, mercy, peace, from God [the] Father, and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
prose: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Father's Son, in truth and love.

literal: I rejoiced greatly that I have found [some] of the children of you walking in truth, just as a commandment we received from the Father.
prose: I rejoiced greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, just as we received a commandment from the Father.

literal: And now I ask you, lady, not as writing to you a new commandment, but [the one] which we were having from [the] beginning, that we love one another.
prose: And now I ask you, lady, not as though writing you a new commandment, but the one we have had from the beginning, that we love one another.

literal: And this is the love, that we might walk according to his commandments; this the commandment is, just as you heard from the beginning, that in it you should walk.
prose: And this is love, that we walk according to his commandments; this is the commandment, just as you heard from the beginning, that you walk in it.

literal: Because many deceivers went out into the world, the ones not confessing Jesus Christ coming in flesh. This [one] is the deceiver and the antichrist.
prose: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who do not confess Jesus Christ coming in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the antichrist.

literal: Watch yourselves, that you may not lose the things which we worked, but may receive a full reward.
prose: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but may receive a full reward.

literal: Everyone, the [one] going-ahead and not remaining in the teaching of-the Christ, God he-does-not have.
prose: Everyone who goes ahead and does not remain in the teaching of Christ does not have God.

literal: If anyone comes to you and this teaching does not bring, do not receive him into house and to rejoice to him do not say
prose: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your house and do not say to him, "Greetings."

literal: For the [one] saying to him, Rejoice, shares in his works, the wicked [ones].
prose: For the one who says a greeting to him shares in his wicked works.

literal: Having many things to write to you, I did not want [to write] through paper and ink, but I hope to come to be with you and to speak mouth to mouth, so that the joy of you may be fulfilled.
prose: Though I have many things to write to you, I did not want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and speak face to face, so that our joy may be fulfilled.

literal: Greet you the children of the sister of you, of the elect [one].
prose: The children of your elect sister greet you.
